verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly support long-duration, serverless-cost pauses: 'No timeouts, elastic scaling' for long-running tasks, waitpoint tokens that 'pause task runs until you complete the token' for external confirmation, and needsApproval tool config that 'pauses for human approval; the run stays alive' without holding compute, plus cron-based scheduled tasks and a documented 'Delayed' run state. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a maximum sleep/wait duration (e.g. confirming months-long waits are supported, not just arbitrary long pauses) and independent/hands-on confirmation of a multi-month wait actually surviving without cost, since community comments (wishlist for 'wait/resume for long running jobs') predate the waitpoint-token feature and aren't a direct test of current behavior.
